title: AETH-01 RunPod canary receipt
description: Shape of receipt.json written by run_canary.py. PASS requires the entire preregistered 200 + 20*5 corpus, no mismatches, and complete source hashes. Controllers must additionally require backend=cupy and match run_id and all three source hashes to their launch inputs; a local numpy_fallback smoke-test PASS is not GPU evidence.

run_id.description: Optional launch binding, copied verbatim from AETH01_RUN_ID at main() entry. Null when unset or empty. Controllers must reject absent, null, or unexpected IDs.

backend.description: numpy_fallback on an actual GPU pod is itself a finding (CuPy failed to import) and forces status=FAIL_ENVIRONMENT unless AETH01_CANARY_REQUIRE_GPU=0 (local smoke-test only) -- never a silent PASS.

status.description: Closed vocabulary. FAIL_INCOMPLETE is the initial placeholder or a final verdict that the full preregistered corpus was not completed.

cases_run.description: Comparisons completed; zero never qualifies for PASS. May be zero for environment, incomplete, or error failures.

single_tick_trials.description: Preregistered single-tick trial count (TRIALS in run_canary.py).

multi_tick_steps.description: Ticks compared per multi-tick trajectory (MULTI_TICK_STEPS); cases_run = single_tick_trials + sum over multi-tick trajectories of (ticks compared up to first divergence, capped at multi_tick_steps).

rng_seed.description: Fixed preregistered seed (RNG_SEED) the trial corpus was drawn from.

gpu_kernel_seconds.description: Wall time of gpu_step bracketed by current CUDA stream synchronization on CuPy, including completion of queued output operations. Excludes initial upload and output download/comparison; not a pure device-kernel benchmark or a pass/fail gate.

mismatches.description: Empty on success. Each first divergence includes the last agreed input grid, all parameters, both full outputs, and every differing cell/field (or output shape).

started_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, written before the corpus runs.

finished_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the final verdict, including a completed but insufficient corpus; null only in the FAIL_INCOMPLETE placeholder.

source_hashes.description: SHA-256 of the raw bytes of the three existing sources beside run_canary.py. Null only in a placeholder or failed run; PASS requires all three digests. Compare with the controller's expected source bytes, not merely with each other.

cost_context.description: Echo of AGE controller quote/budget/process-timeout inputs, not actual spend or a billing guarantee; all null when run standalone (e.g. local smoke test).

error.description: Present only when status == FAIL_ERROR: repr() of the unhandled exception.

output.description: Each field is its full host array converted with tolist(), normally an H-by-W matrix. Malformed output shapes are retained rather than discarded.
